documents: The indoor heated pool is open 24 hours a day for all guests.
Our outdoor pool overlooks the garden and is open from 7 AM to 9 PM.
The fitness center is open 24/7 and includes free weights and cardio machines.
Room service is available around the clock, including late-night snacks.
Breakfast buffet is served every morning from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM.
High-speed Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms.
Standard check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is by 12:00 PM noon.
Our on-site spa offers massages and facials by appointment only.
Self-parking is available on-site for a nightly fee of $20.
